source: Haiku triage of pending review items + OBA lane triage, 2026-10-10. Kinds: duplicate (covered by an installed model), skip (no building of its own), sculpture, area.

Amsterdamse Hogeschool voor de Kunsten.note: Academy of arts; occupies rooms in buildings near Weesperplein, no own landmark building. BAG pand shared with Academie voor Theater en Dans.

Decembermoorden.note: December murders memorial near Plantage; memorial object, not a building.

Nederlandse Film en Televisie Academie.note: Film and Television Academy; school occupying rooms in an ordinary building.

Academie van Bouwkunst.note: Academy of Architecture; school in ordinary building, no BAG pand matched at point.

Academie voor Theater en Dans.note: Academy of Theatre and Dance; shares pand 0363100012185844 with AHK.

De Ateliers.note: De Ateliers studio complex; organisation in mixed-use building.

Shadow quay.note: Ambiguous quay name; treat as public place/quayside, not a building. Verify name.

Dutch East Indian Company.note: Covered by installed model oost-indisch-huis. Covered by oost-indisch-huis (Oost-Indisch Huis and Bushuis); point is ~15 m from its footprint centre. BAG pand 0363100012165008 (bouwjaar 1606).

Bevrijdingslinde.note: Bevrijdingslinde: commemorative lime tree, memorial object.

Sint-Petrus-en-Pauluskerk.note: Covered by installed model petrus-en-paulus-kerk. Same landmark as petrus-en-paulus-kerk (identical extract id).

Nationaal Holocaust Namenmonument.note: Nationaal Holocaust Namenmonument: memorial, not covered by national-holocaust-museum (different site).

Voormalige Schouwburgpoort.note: Schouwburg gateway (poort) fragment, memorial/monument element rather than a full building. Verify.

Oudemanhuispoort.note: Covered by installed model oudemanhuispoort. Same landmark as oudemanhuispoort (identical extract id).

Maarten Lutherkerk.note: Covered by installed model maarten-lutherkerk. Same landmark as maarten-lutherkerk (identical extract id).

Koningskerk.note: Covered by installed model koningskerk. Same landmark as koningskerk (identical extract id).

Kraan 2868.note: Harbour crane Kraan 2868: preserved industrial object/monument, not a building.

Monument voor Damslachtoffers 7 mei 1945.note: Memorial for 7 May 1945 Dam victims; memorial object. Not the same as national-monument-on-the-dam (checked by name, ~90 m apart). Verify.

Compagnietheater.note: Covered by installed model compagnietheater. Same landmark as compagnietheater (identical extract id). BAG bouwjaar on that pand reads 1005, which is suspect.

Royal Tropical Institute.note: Covered by installed model wereldmuseum-amsterdam. Royal Tropical Institute is covered by wereldmuseum-amsterdam (KIT complex). Per user note.

Vrijburg.note: Vrijburg: multi-building complex/area, not a single building.

Rijksakademie van beeldende kunsten.note: Rijksakademie: school occupying rooms in an existing building (pand 0363100012165748, 1865).

Three-climate Greenhouse.note: Covered by installed model hortus-greenhouses. Driekliman (three-climate) glasshouse is part of the Hortus greenhouse complex covered by hortus-greenhouses; ~70 m from that catalogue centre. Verify footprint covers it.

Westertoren.note: Covered by installed model westerkerk. Westertoren is the tower of westerkerk (Westerkerk / Westertoren). Pand 0363100012174221.

OBA Olympisch Kwartier.note: Library occupies part of an ordinary building (ground floor of a 2005 block); BAG triage 2026-10-10, not photo-checked.

OBA Javaplein.note: Library occupies part of an ordinary building (2011 new-build block); BAG triage 2026-10-10, not photo-checked.

OBA Staatsliedenbuurt.note: Library occupies part of an ordinary building (ground floor in a 2005 block); BAG triage 2026-10-10, not photo-checked.

OBA Mercatorplein.note: Library occupies part of an ordinary building (ordinary 1927 perimeter-block corner); BAG triage 2026-10-10, not photo-checked.

OBA Spaarndammerbuurt.note: Library occupies part of an ordinary building (1981 infill); BAG triage 2026-10-10, not photo-checked.

OBA Bos en Lommer.note: Library occupies part of an ordinary building (ground-floor unit in small 1940 panden); BAG triage 2026-10-10, not photo-checked.

OBA Linnaeus.note: Library occupies part of an ordinary building (ordinary 1916 block ground floor); BAG triage 2026-10-10, not photo-checked.

OBA Van der Pek.note: Library occupies part of an ordinary building (small 1923 block unit); BAG triage 2026-10-10, not photo-checked.

OBA CC Amstel.note: Library occupies part of an ordinary building (part of the 2018 Amstel campus complex); BAG triage 2026-10-10, not photo-checked.

CEDLA Library.note: Library occupies part of an ordinary building (reading room inside a university canal complex); BAG triage 2026-10-10, not photo-checked.

Elthetokerk.note: Demolished in 1992 (nl.wikipedia); every BAG pand within ~60 m is 1912–16 housing. Keep as a quiz POI only.

Max Euwe Centrum.note: Rooms inside the former Huis van Bewaring block (pand 0363100012168688), which De Balie models.

Bijzondere Collecties.note: University library inside a canal-house block (pand 0363100012168172), not a distinct building.
